name: S&P Global Inc.
blurb: S&P Global Inc. is a leading provider of financial intelligence, credit ratings, benchmarks, and analytics. Its core divisions include S&P Global Ratings (one of the world's three major credit rating agencies), S&P Global Market Intelligence (data and research platforms), S&P Global Commodity Insights, and S&P Dow Jones Indices, which administers the S&P 500 and thousands of other indices. The company significantly expanded its scale through the 2022 merger with IHS Markit, reinforcing its position as a critical infrastructure provider for global capital markets.
recent: Shares fell approximately 4.15% on May 13, 2026, closing at $406.55 — a notable single-day decline that prompted coverage on MarketBeat asking why the stock dropped, though the specific catalyst is not detailed in available sources.
